import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] input = read(scanner);
        int h = input[0];
        int n = input[1] - 1;

        String binaryStr = Integer.toBinaryString(n);
        binaryStr = "0".repeat(h - binaryStr.length()) + binaryStr;

        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
            if (i > 0 && binaryStr.charAt(i - 1) == '0') {
                result.append(binaryStr.charAt(i) == '0' ? '1' : '0');
            } else {
                result.append(binaryStr.charAt(i));
            }
        }

        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
            total += 1;
            if (result.charAt(i) == '1') {
                total += Math.pow(2, h - i) - 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static int[] read(Scanner scanner) {
        String data = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        String[] parts = data.split("\\s+");
        int[] nums = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            nums[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return nums;
    }
}
